name: Valluércanes (Spain)
description: Square flag divided per saltire, blue at the hoist and fly and red above and below, charged at the centre with the crowned municipal arms of Valluércanes (a bell on red above a bridge and waves).
history: Municipal flag of Valluércanes; Spanish municipal flags are approved by the municipal council and the autonomous community and published in the regional official gazette.
